reasons: Lobby security needs only admit/route; reading a family-court notice aloud exposes the matter to a contractor, but the design is mostly a sealed-pass access-control problem; onion-routing borrowing is loosely used.
context_purpose: Admit legitimate visitors to a shared judicial building and direct them to the right floor.

norm_violation_today.reason: A private contractor learns the family-court matter, parties and room when it only needs entry and floor.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The guard cannot verify the notice contents or later reconstruct who attended which matter, which is not needed for routing.

transmission_check.reason: Access control only needs proof of a valid session today; I know of no rule requiring the contractor to log the matter itself.

reasons: Rosters of religious affiliation passed to bus operators is a real over-flow of sensitive data, but membership sets are tiny, temples are informal issuers, and the host knows riders by face; the onion relay is decorative and the jury borrowing is only an analogy.
context_purpose: Allocate limited congregation-rate seats to genuine followers of participating branch temples and run the trip logistics.

norm_violation_today.reason: The bus operator and stop vendors receive religion and ID number that only the host needs, if even that.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Safety and insurance may require named passenger lists, which an anonymous ticket cannot supply.

transmission_check.reason: Riders volunteer details for the discount, but passenger-insurance or transport rules may require names and I cannot confirm them.

reasons: Retained photocopies of ID and household transcripts at a township office are a genuine over-collection, but the office is a government body with record duties and the programme needs parcel and kinship links beyond bare status.
context_purpose: Confirm that an applicant holds indigenous status and is eligible once for reserved-land use or loan programmes.

norm_violation_today.reason: A government office is entitled to verify status, but indefinite paper copies of full family details exceed the stated need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Linking the person to a specific parcel, residence or kinship and de-duplicating enrolment require more than a status claim.

transmission_check.reason: Administrative case files probably must be kept and may require document copies, but I cannot confirm the specific rule.

reasons: A threshold on sales history is a clean predicate and the screenshots leak third-party buyer data, but issuers mostly do not exist, cross-issuer summing needs a binding identifier, and the verifier is a commercial platform with no legal duty.
context_purpose: Decide whether a new seller is established enough to list high-value items on the trusted-seller tier.

norm_violation_today.reason: Screenshots expose buyers' names and addresses (third parties) and an ID photo when only a count is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The marketplace cannot inspect item types or review text for fraud patterns, which a count does not give.

transmission_check.reason: The app chooses its own onboarding evidence with no legal duty, so a threshold proof is acceptable if it wishes.

reasons: Collecting party membership (special-category-like political data) via screenshots for a members-only vote is a clear over-collection, and membership plus a nullifier is a good fit; weakness is rare, tiny-scale use and an uncertain issuer.
context_purpose: Confirm that a voter is a party member in the district and votes once per round.

norm_violation_today.reason: Volunteers store ID photos, home address and party affiliation, sensitive political data, when only membership and uniqueness matter.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Organisers cannot contact members or audit identities beyond the nullifier, which the vote does not need.

transmission_check.reason: Participants hand over details to join and obtain the discount; no law I know of requires a volunteer forum to keep ID copies.

reasons: Age check at an unattended alcohol locker is the textbook threshold proof, but it is a close rewording of the known age-gated online purchase; regulator log expectations and the locker's retained image are the only twists.
context_purpose: Ensure alcohol is sold only to adults at an unattended point of sale.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full ID image with address and ID number is stored in the sale log when only an age of at least 18 is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The operator cannot later show which adult bought which item unless a pseudonymous receipt is accepted as the log.

transmission_check.reason: Age-restricted sale rules likely oblige the seller to check age, but whether a stored ID image is demanded is unknown to me.

reasons: Public registry facts mean a ZK attestation prevents little; the collector can scrape registers and the attestation would need the holder, a debtor, to cooperate, which they have no reason to do; the verifier is adversarial to the holder.
context_purpose: Determine whether a debtor holds a company directorship to pursue recovery.

norm_violation_today.reason: Each register is public, but cross-referencing land and household data to build a home-address dossier may exceed the collection purpose.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Collectors usually need the company identity and a service address to act, which a bare yes/no does not give.

transmission_check.reason: Nothing blocks asking for less, but public registers let the collector skip the proof entirely.

reasons: Landlords photocopying ARCs and kept in chat is a real over-collection for a vulnerable group and a freshness predicate suits it, but landlords have no clear duty to verify, the issuing registry is a high bar, and it echoes the known landlord case.
context_purpose: Confirm that a migrant tenant remains legally employed before renewing a lease.

norm_violation_today.reason: The landlord keeps full ARC, passport and permit copies indefinitely when a current-status check would do.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The landlord cannot identify the employer or contact details, which a lease does not require but a dispute might.

transmission_check.reason: Rules on renting to foreign workers may exist for landlords or employers; I cannot confirm whether any require copies.
